download_and_merge_peft_model: download a PEFT model, merge LoRA weights, and save the merged model with tokenizer to a directory
download_peft_model_only: download a PEFT model for causal or seq2seq LM without merging weights
merge_lora_weights: merge LoRA adapter weights into the base model and unload the PEFT wrapper
save_merged_model: save a merged PEFT model, its config, and tokenizer to a local cache directory
load_peft_causal_or_seq2seq: load a PEFT model trying causal LM first then falling back to seq2seq LM
